name: Base P/T taken from a target creature — Riptide Mangler, Halfdane, Sworn Defender
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. The number comes from another object picked after the ability is fired (Battlefield.setRefPerm; the 'Value from' picker). The effect stays on the ability's source and reads the picked creature's stats from the fire-time snapshot, so the Glorious Anthem added afterwards changes nothing that was locked: Craw Wurm was 6/4 when each ability resolved. Sworn Defender: power = toughness - 1, toughness = 1 + power.

scryfallData.name: Craw Wurm
scryfallData.flavor_text: The most terrifying thing about the craw wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

scryfallData.name: Riptide Mangler
scryfallData.oracle_text: {1}{U}: This creature's base power becomes equal to target creature's power. (This effect lasts indefinitely.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: It wants you to be its chum.

scryfallData.name: Halfdane
scryfallData.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, Halfdane's base power and toughness become equal to the power and toughness of target creature other than Halfdane until the end of your next upkeep.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Hail from Tolaria the ever changing 'Dane.

scryfallData.name: Sworn Defender
scryfallData.oracle_text: {1}: This creature's power becomes the toughness of target creature blocking or being blocked by this creature minus 1 until end of turn, and its toughness becomes 1 plus the power of that creature until end of turn.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Glorious Anthem
scryfallData.flavor_text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.
